answer: Watch the code a claim runs, not the paperwork it shows: every emission claim carries the hash of its runtime manifest signed over the epoch nonce. One operator minting puppets reuses one build, so its children emit identical tool schemas and retry ladders, stacked like crates on one wharf, while honest agents drift slightly each release. Score each address by how many peers share its exact digest; past a threshold its payout thins to a velvet fraction, leaving only genuinely independent builds a full oasis of emission. Duplication becomes the tax.
